description: Computes a clipped span of rows and columns, then repeatedly replaces bytes through a lookup table over several passes. Blitter registers are loaded around the work and the row edges are handled separately.

name: clip_and_blit_record_rectangle
description: Clips a record's rectangle against a set of bounds and returns when it lies outside them. Otherwise it selects edge masks from the record's type code, loads the blitter, waits for it to finish and starts the blit.

name: run_library_call_sequence
description: Calls four subroutines and a graphics vector, then a second vector when a flag is set, then three vectors from one table and three from another. It returns zero.

name: dispatch_bytes_through_jump_table
description: Reads bytes from a stream one at a time and calls the routine selected by each byte through a 16-bit jump table. The recovered loop has no exit.

name: run_library_call_sequence_b
description: Repeats the call sequence of its neighbour: four subroutines, a graphics vector, an optional second vector, then two sets of three library vectors. It returns zero.

name: mark_undecoded_routine_body
description: Eight instructions that the decompiler could not decode, so the body is not recovered. The routine has two unnamed callers.

name: copy_word_to_indexed_slot
description: Copies one 16-bit word from a source pointer into a slot indexed by two registers. The rest of the listing is bad instruction data, so no further behaviour is recovered.

name: mark_undecoded_routine_calls
description: Eight instructions with three unnamed calls that the decompiler could not decode. Only those calls are recorded.

name: process_step_record_stream
description: Reads a command record: a minus-two code copies sixteen words into a buffer, while other codes walk a stream of step records, accumulating position words and setting state bytes in a table entry.

name: walk_step_records_and_mark
description: Walks a stream of step records, accumulating position words, and marks a table entry with two. A minus-two code instead copies sixteen words into a buffer, and the routine then writes an output record with a state byte and position words.

name: accumulate_step_records_count
description: Walks a counted run of step records, accumulating position words and negating them when a flag bit is set. It then stores the final accumulator values and returns.

name: write_output_record_and_mark
description: Marks a table entry with two when it is zero, then writes an output record with a state byte, frame-derived fields and position words.

name: mark_free_entry_and_record
description: Scans a table for the first zero byte and marks it with two, then writes an output record with frame values and position words.

name: write_record_with_optional_mark
description: Marks a table entry with two when the condition flag is clear, then writes an output record from frame values and position words.

name: scan_list_until_flag_clear
description: Walks a sequence of nodes, calling subroutines and checking a node byte at each step. It clears a global flag and returns when the walk ends.

name: compare_node_fields_no_effect
description: Compares a node's linked field and two values, then returns in every case without changing anything.

name: compare_node_value_no_effect
description: Compares two node fields with a frame value and a global byte, then returns without any effect.

name: return_without_effect_f
description: Returns immediately with no effect.

name: search_sorted_node_list
description: Walks a linked list ordered by key, comparing each key with a frame value and a global byte, and returns once it has passed the position. It writes nothing.

name: search_node_list_by_key
description: Follows node links, comparing each node's key with a data register value and a byte, and returns on a match or when a greater key is reached. It changes nothing.

name: return_without_effect_g
description: Returns immediately with no effect.

name: scan_node_list_for_key
description: Walks a node list while the key is not greater than a frame value, then returns without changing anything.

name: step_node_list_by_key
description: Follows node links while the stored key is below a data register value and returns at the end of the list. Nothing is written.

name: return_without_effect_h
description: Returns immediately with no effect.

name: insert_node_into_list
description: When the list head is nonzero, unlinks a node from the head, fills in its key, frame value and flag byte, and links it into a sub-list. When the head is zero it calls two subroutines and stores an argument in the frame.

name: link_node_after_head
description: Writes a node's link, key, frame value and flag byte, then links it into a list at the position given by a register. It has no empty-list path.

name: call_pair_then_store_value
description: Calls two subroutines and stores an argument into a frame word. The facts also list a text fragment that the code does not use.

name: store_two_frame_bytes
description: Calls a subroutine, stores an argument byte in one frame field, calls it again and stores the same argument in a second frame byte.

name: compute_scaled_object_position
description: Computes an object's position from a record offset, a table entry and size fields, scaling the offsets when the record flags allow it. It stores the resulting position and size.

name: select_field_when_flag_clear
description: Returns the input pair unchanged when a flag byte is negative, otherwise it returns a byte field from a record in the low half.

name: lookup_offset_table_entry
description: When a global flag is zero, follows a pointer chain and returns the entry selected by a data register index. Otherwise it calls a subroutine and returns its result.

name: lookup_indexed_table_entry
description: Follows a pointer chain and returns the entry selected by a data register index, with no flag check.

name: call_routine_then_return
description: Calls one subroutine and returns.

name: repeat_call_until_zero
description: Stores a byte in a global, then calls subroutines in a loop depending on whether that byte was zero, and returns.

name: loop_two_calls_while_flagged
description: Repeats two subroutine calls for as long as a flag remains set, then returns.

name: call_until_zero_result
description: Calls a subroutine repeatedly while a frame word is nonzero and each result is nonzero, then returns.

name: relink_node_by_flag_byte
description: Reads a flag byte at a list position and, depending on its sign, updates the list head or links the node around it. It then calls a subroutine and returns its result.

name: update_linked_list_node
description: Removes a node from a linked list by replacing the head or the link that points to it, using the node's successor.

name: store_value_into_three_words
description: Calls subroutines and writes one argument value into three consecutive words.

name: copy_two_longs_to_globals
description: Copies two 32-bit values from the pointer in the frame into two global locations.

name: shift_node_list_positions
description: When a three-word delta is nonzero, adds the delta to the position words of every node in a linked list and marks each node with a flag.

name: offset_record_and_mark_list
description: Adds three offset words to a record's position fields, marks each zero entry in a linked list with a flag, and clears the record's top bit.

name: process_node_list_with_trap
description: Walks a list of nodes whose type byte selects a copy, a relink or a removal, copying position fields between entries. It swaps two buffer pointers and issues a trap at the end.

name: update_node_list_by_type
description: Walks a linked list of nodes, dispatching on each node's type byte to subroutines that relink or remove nodes and copy position fields. A flag and a comparison of two stored values decide the path.

name: insert_and_update_node_list
description: Links a new node at the head of a list, then walks the list dispatching on node type bytes and copying position fields, in a similar way to its neighbour.

name: write_to_table_offset
description: Writes a link word and four record fields, including a global value, at offsets from a record index, then calls two subroutines.

name: copy_table_entry
description: Copies a link word from one table position to another, stores the previously held global value in the new entry, and updates the global with the new position.

name: write_record_fields_after_calls
description: Calls two subroutines, writes a link word and four record fields at offsets from a register index, then calls two more subroutines.

name: initialize_global_bounds
description: Sets two bound globals to 32767 and two more to minus 32768, the starting values for a minimum and maximum search.

name: expand_bounds_with_record
description: When a record's flag is nonnegative, widens four global bounds to include the record's position and its size offsets.

name: insert_node_in_sorted_order
description: Walks a linked list to find where a node belongs, comparing its key, a byte and a second byte in order, then links the node in front of that position.

name: process_flagged_node_lists
description: When a node's flag bit is clear, walks linked entries and applies subroutines to those whose flags and values pass checks. It then re-checks the node's marker byte before returning.

name: clamp_rect_bounds
description: Checks whether a rectangle overlaps the global bounds and, if it does, clamps its edges to those bounds and sets a result flag. It returns without a result when the rectangle lies outside.

name: expand_rect_bounds
description: Checks that a table rectangle overlaps the current range, then records the intersection and the widened extent in globals and sets a result flag. Otherwise it clears the flag.

name: compute_node_intersection_bounds
description: Derives bound globals from a node's rectangle when a flag is zero, then tests whether the node lies within the current bounds and, if so, stores the clipped bounds and a buffer offset.

name: return_empty_routine
description: Performs no operations and returns immediately.

name: return_without_effect_i
description: Returns immediately with no effect.

name: clear_table_entry
description: Calls a subroutine, then when an index is nonnegative writes zero to a byte at an address taken from a table at that index.

name: copy_sixteen_words_into_buffer
description: Copies up to sixteen words from a record into a global buffer, with the count taken from a record byte minus one, then sets a status byte to minus one.

name: set_global_status_minus_one
description: Sets a global status byte to minus one and returns.

name: store_word_in_indexed_table
description: Calls subroutines, then when a status byte is not one and an index is below 32, stores a word in that table slot and calls a subroutine.

name: store_word_and_call
description: When an index is below 32, stores a word in that table slot and calls a subroutine.

name: store_word_at_index_unchecked
description: Stores a word in a table slot chosen by an index, without a range check, then calls a subroutine.

name: compare_nibble_sum_no_effect
description: Adds the low nibbles of two words and tests the sum against sixteen, but both outcomes return without changing anything.

name: compare_nibble_difference_no_effect
description: Subtracts the low nibbles of two words and returns in each case without changing anything.

name: return_without_effect_j
description: Returns immediately with no effect.

name: return_without_effect_k
description: Returns immediately with no effect.

name: copy_pattern_block_into_buffer
description: Copies a block of words from a byte-coded record into a global buffer. When a second value is nonzero it sets global flags from its high nibble, otherwise it sets four status bytes to one.

name: copy_pattern_block_unchecked
description: Copies a block of words from a byte-coded record into a global buffer when the record's first byte is minus two, then sets status bytes from a second value.

name: copy_block_from_record_offset
description: Copies a block of sixteen words, sized by a record byte, into a global buffer, then sets status bytes according to a second value.

name: set_status_from_nibble
description: Sets a global status to fifteen and to one of several values derived from the high nibble of a value, then sets a final flag.

name: reconcile_nibble_buffers
description: Walks 32 entries of two global buffers, comparing the low nibble of each pair and calling a routine to apply each difference.

name: merge_buffers_by_low_nibble
description: Merges two word buffers in order of their low nibbles, calling a routine to advance the side that is smaller and writing combined words to the output until the count runs out.

name: merge_buffers_by_high_nibble
description: Merges two word buffers by comparing the high nibbles of each pair and writes combined words to the output, following the same pattern as its neighbour with low nibbles.

name: merge_buffers_by_third_nibble
description: Merges two word buffers by comparing nibbles at successive positions and writes packed words to the output until the count runs out.

name: set_status_after_buffer_copy
description: Returns when a flag is set. Otherwise it copies a 32-word global buffer onto itself, then sets status bytes from a high-nibble value.

name: copy_global_buffer_then_status
description: Copies a 32-word global buffer onto itself, then sets status bytes from a high-nibble value. It is the same as its neighbour without the flag check.

name: call_routine_then_return_b
description: Calls one subroutine and returns.

name: call_routine_then_return_c
description: Calls one subroutine and returns.

name: store_value_in_status_globals
description: Stores a value into several status globals through subroutine calls, then when the value is nonzero clears one global and sets another flag.

name: set_flag_and_store_value
description: Clears a flag global, sets another to one, stores an argument in a status word and calls a subroutine.

name: store_clamped_record_fields
description: Selects a pointer and a size between a global and a limit, then writes a record of status and value fields to that location when the size fits the limit.

name: call_three_routines_then_return
description: Calls three subroutines in turn and returns.

name: lookup_record_pointer_or_call
description: When a flag is zero, finds an entry in a record at a register index and returns its pointer. Otherwise it calls a subroutine and returns its result.

name: lookup_record_pointer_entry
description: Finds an entry in a record at a register index and returns its pointer.
